day_result_minutes.name: day_result_minutes
day_result_minutes.value: "day_result"."required_minutes" >= 0 AND ("day_result"."worked_minutes" IS NULL OR "day_result"."worked_minutes" >= 0) AND "day_result"."late_minutes" >= 0 AND "day_result"."overtime_minutes" >= 0 AND "day_result"."paid_ot_minutes" >= 0 AND "day_result"."unpaid_extra_minutes" >= 0

day_result_swap.name: day_result_swap
day_result_swap.value: ("day_result"."swap_request_id" IS NULL) = ("day_result"."swap_role" IS NULL) AND NOT ("day_result"."unauth_swap" AND "day_result"."swap_request_id" IS NOT NULL)

staff_national_id_dates.name: staff_national_id_dates
staff_national_id_dates.value: "staff"."national_id_expires_on" IS NULL OR "staff"."national_id_issued_on" IS NULL OR "staff"."national_id_expires_on" >= "staff"."national_id_issued_on"

pattern_slots_shape.name: pattern_slots_shape
pattern_slots_shape.value: array_ndims("pattern"."slots") = 1 AND CASE "pattern"."type" WHEN 'weekly' THEN cardinality("pattern"."slots") = 7 ELSE cardinality("pattern"."slots") BETWEEN 1 AND 28 END

pattern_pay_rule_rate_range.name: pattern_pay_rule_rate_range
pattern_pay_rule_rate_range.value: ("pattern_pay_rule"."work_day_rate" IS NULL OR "pattern_pay_rule"."work_day_rate" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND ("pattern_pay_rule"."off_day_rate" IS NULL OR "pattern_pay_rule"."off_day_rate" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND ("pattern_pay_rule"."holiday_rate" IS NULL OR "pattern_pay_rule"."holiday_rate" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

swap_request_other_staff.name: swap_request_other_staff
swap_request_other_staff.value: ("swap_request"."kind" = 'emp_swap') = ("swap_request"."other_staff_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("swap_request"."other_staff_id" IS NULL OR "swap_request"."other_staff_id" <> "swap_request"."staff_id")

swap_request_dates.name: swap_request_dates
swap_request_dates.value: ("swap_request"."kind" <> 'self_swap' OR "swap_request"."second_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("swap_request"."second_date" IS NULL OR "swap_request"."second_date" <> "swap_request"."first_date")

swap_request_state_fields.name: swap_request_state_fields
swap_request_state_fields.value: ("swap_request"."state" = 'pending') = ("swap_request"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "swap_request"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) AND ("swap_request"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("swap_request"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("swap_request"."state" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR "swap_request"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("swap_request"."cancelled_at" IS NULL OR length(trim(coalesce("swap_request"."cancel_reason", ''))) > 0)
